create_instance_seg_evaluator: create an InstanceSegEvaluator to evaluate instance segmentation predictions using COCO metrics
run_eval_predictions: run the _eval_predictions method to evaluate bbox, segm, or keypoints predictions on COCO format results
remap_category_ids: remap contiguous category IDs back to original dataset IDs for COCO evaluation compatibility
save_coco_results_json: save instance segmentation prediction results to a COCO format JSON file in the output directory
derive_coco_results: derive COCO evaluation results for a specific task using the _derive_coco_results inherited method
